text.content: Test whether token-to-slot competition, balanced local assignments, cross-object and cross-episode negatives, and main-action-gradient supervision prevent the R3 predictive objectives from being solved by a shared collapsed representation and make aligned cross-replan memory causally useful.

Focused tests and distributed BF16 GPU smoke pass; eight-B200 training completes 500 finite optimizer steps and saves a complete checkpoint; slot mean absolute off-diagonal cosine is below 0.95; positive temporal similarity exceeds both cross-object and cross-episode negative similarity by at least 0.05; action-gradient valid fraction is positive and its loss has finite nonzero gradients; on the identical held-out stream and seed, aligned-history main action loss is at least 1% lower than both zero and shuffled interventions. No 20k run unless every gate passes.

R3 fixed-scale memory cross-attention/FiLM plus 8 competitive slots; diversity 0.20; assignment entropy/balance/spatial compactness 0.05 each; temporal 0.02; cross-object and cross-episode contrastive 0.10 each at temperature 0.07; local action-gradient alignment 0.05; memory-only action auxiliary 0.25; B4 warm start; train strong_action_expert; 500 steps; batch 64/rank; DP8; matched none/zero/shuffle validation.

RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus 1,143,698-record triple-view Wan latent cache and episode-safe t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history sidecar; per-sample episode ID added only for training negative exclusion and cross-rank negatives; no future lookup.
wam@208.64.254.190; pyrogpucompute1; cwam-b4-runtime:ngc25.09-ffmpeg6; /data0/wam/cwam-b4/env/cosmos-cu130; offline model assets.
Eight-rank R4 B4-warm probe with strong_action_expert optimizer scope, followed by exact-checkpoint validation-only none, zero, and shuffle cells on the same held-out stream.
pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; effective global batch 512.

Aligned/zero/shuffle main action losses and relative gains; slot absolute cosine; assignment entropy/balance/compactness; positive, cross-object-negative, and cross-episode-negative similarity margins; action-gradient alignment loss, valid fraction, and target entropy; memory-only action loss; step time; GPU memory, utilization, and power.

R3 made the predictive auxiliary easy to optimize but converged to slot absolute cosine 0.9996318, while aligned history improved held-out main action loss by only 0.013% versus zero and 0.006% versus shuffle. R4 forces local token competition, object identity discrimination across time and episodes, and policy-gradient-aligned object selection. The terminal decision remains the main-policy none/zero/shuffle gate rather than auxiliary loss reduction alone.
